scripts.build: npm run build -w @repellet/agent-protocol && npm run build -w @repellet/shared && npm run build -w @repellet/bridge && npm run build -w @repellet/api && npm run build -w @repellet/worker && npm run build -w @repellet/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @repellet/agent-protocol && npm run build -w @repellet/shared && ADDITIONAL_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 concurrently -k -n api,worker,web 'npm run dev -w @repellet/api' 'npm run dev -w @repellet/worker' 'npm run dev -w @repellet/web'
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @repellet/agent-protocol && npm run build -w @repellet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:docker: RUN_DOCKER_TESTS=1 vitest run tests/docker.test.ts tests/agent-docker.test.ts tests/backup.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
